technique.comparisonQuestion: Can registered authored canopy poses retain the strong cutout trunk and plants while eliminating the visible gap and misplaced leaves?

control.name: Round 1 key-pose island formation
control.implementation: The established app-native SVG arrive-ground treatment remains unchanged: opacity plus additive scale from 0.78 to 1 over 850 ms, with no generated island and no native island growth layer.
control.knownOwnerVerdict: Best Round 1 island formation, but still below the bar because it reads as fading in rather than growing from nothing.

referencePlate.source: Real Studio consumer using the app-owned SVG island and its established low-isometric camera.
referencePlate.camera: Existing app-owned camera, island, coast, world anchor and geometry are invariant and are not raster runtime assets.

authoring.normalizationPolicy: Retain one connected palette-matched PixelLab crown, move its lower attachment onto the fixed registration plate at author/import time, and author the same opaque overlap collar into every pose. Runtime correction is forbidden.
authoring.observedModelLimitation: PixFlux produced whole-tree studies despite foliage-only prompts. Generated land and wood were excluded by deterministic author-time palette segmentation; only the connected foliage crown informed the registered endpoints.
authoring.rejectedReferences: sources/rejected-canopy-*-reference.png are audit-only Round 1 evidence and are never imported at runtime.

painterOrder: registered canopy pose with overlap collar
